name: Jenny
quote: Peter has been a solid support for me over the last 12 weeks. He pushes me to go further than I think I can. I’ve learnt a lot about training, keeping my body fuelled and resting when I need to.

name: Craig
quote: Since coming it has improved my speed and stamina while shedding a couple of pounds into the bargain. It is a sociable group and Peter makes the intense training fun.
